Total Elapsed Damage is calculated as Burn Damage × (Burn Duration ÷ Burn Tick).
DPS assumes that only one enemy is hit per swing and it is set on fire.
Ability is not taken into account.
Burn DPS is calculated as (Burn Damage * (Burn Duration / Burn Tick)) / Burn Cooldown.
DPS assumes that the maximum number of enemies are hit per swing. For burn, it only accounts for the number of enemies hit in a swing.
Ability is not taken into account.
